import random, json, subprocess, sys, time
sys.path.insert(0,'/app/tmp/work')
import checker

def big_request(rng, n=96, m=384, k=96, per=8):
    edges=[]
    for _ in range(m):
        t=rng.randrange(n); h=rng.randrange(n)
        while h==t: h=rng.randrange(n)
        edges.append({"tail":t,"head":h,"capacity":rng.randint(50,1024)})
    adj=[[] for _ in range(n)]
    for eid,e in enumerate(edges): adj[e["tail"]].append((eid,e["head"]))
    def paths_between(s,t,cnt):
        res=[]
        for _ in range(cnt*8):
            if len(res)>=cnt: break
            cur=s; path=[]; visited={s}; ok=False
            for _ in range(n+1):
                if cur==t: ok=True; break
                outs=[o for o in adj[cur] if o[1] not in visited]
                if not outs: break
                eid,head=rng.choice(outs); path.append(eid); visited.add(head); cur=head
            if ok and cur==t and path and path not in res:
                res.append(list(path))
        return res
    comms=[]
    total=0
    for _ in range(k):
        if total>=768: break
        s=rng.randrange(n); t=rng.randrange(n)
        while t==s: t=rng.randrange(n)
        ps=paths_between(s,t,min(per,768-total))
        if not ps: continue
        parts=len(ps)
        cuts=sorted(rng.randint(0,16) for _ in range(parts-1))
        prev=[]; last=0
        for cc in cuts+[16]: prev.append(cc-last); last=cc
        comms.append({"source":s,"target":t,"demand":rng.randint(0,1024),"paths":ps,"previous":prev})
        total+=parts
    failed=[]
    budget=rng.randint(0,98304)
    return {"epoch":rng.randint(0,2**31-1),"node_count":n,"edges":edges,"commodities":comms,"failed_edges":failed,"budget":budget}

rng=random.Random(7)
for trial in range(4):
    req=big_request(rng)
    P=sum(len(c["paths"]) for c in req["commodities"])
    print("trial",trial,"edges",len(req["edges"]),"comms",len(req["commodities"]),"paths",P)
    t0=time.time()
    p=subprocess.run([sys.executable,"/app/submission/planner.py"],input=(json.dumps(req)+"\n").encode(),capture_output=True)
    dt=time.time()-t0
    r=json.loads(p.stdout.splitlines()[0]) if p.stdout.strip() else {"status":"NOOUT"}
    errs,_=checker.check(req,r)
    print("  time %.2fs"%dt,"status",r.get("status"),"errs",errs[:3],"stderr",p.stderr.decode()[:200])
